# Named Period

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NamedPeriod`](gmeow-NamedPeriod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NamedPeriod>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)

A named stretch of time with defined bounds — a geologic era, historical dynasty, artistic period, fiscal year, or any other culturally salient temporal division.
